g.text: Fixed (hand-designed) 3×3 and 9×9 kernels convolved with a 480 × 480-pixel crop (about 40 m per pixel) of a Landsat 5 image of Las Vegas, Nevada, 2
November 2011 (bands 7, 4, 2; NASA/USGS). Red and blue: positive and negative responses. A trained CNN learns similar filters in its first layer.
